characters.basePrompt: armored alchemist warrior, dark medieval plate armor etched with golden alchemical symbols, hooded dark cloak, wielding a glowing runic longsword, strong silhouette, 3/4 isometric view low camera angle like Hades by Supergiant Games, showing front and slight top of character, hand-painted ink style with bold black outlines, dark fantasy game art

animations.name: idle
animations.choreography: breathing idle stance, sword held at right side pointing down, weight centered, cloak gently swaying, four phases of subtle weight shift

animations.name: attack
animations.choreography: overhead sword slash sequence, first beat winds up with sword behind head, second and third swing forward with full body rotation, fourth beat follow-through with sword extended

animations.name: hit
animations.choreography: impact reaction, first beat recoils backward with head snapping, second beat staggers with hand on chest, third beat stumbles catching balance, fourth beat recovering upright

animations.name: death
animations.choreography: defeat collapse, first beat knees buckling sword dropping, second beat falling to one knee, third beat crumpling sideways, fourth beat lying flat on ground armor cracked

animations.name: idle
animations.choreography: hovering menacingly with flames rippling upward from shoulders, weight shifting left to right

animations.name: attack
animations.choreography: lunging forward with both flaming fists extended, fire trail arcing behind, explosive impact pose

animations.name: hit
animations.choreography: flinching backward as flames flicker and dim momentarily, cracks widening on rocky body

animations.name: death
animations.choreography: flames extinguishing from top down, rocky body crumbling into cooling dark stone fragments

animations.name: idle

animations.name: hit
